title: Multicenter iEEG dataset for classification of graphoelements and artifactual signals (FNUSA)
description: This dataset contains 3-second single-channel intracranial EEG (stereo-EEG) clips from patients at St. Anne's University Hospital (FNUSA), annotated for classification of physiological and pathological graphoelements and artifactual signals. It is a BIDS conversion of the segmented .mat archives from Nejedly et al. 2020. Clips are concatenated per subject and source contact at 5000 Hz, with events preserving labels, anatomy, reviewer ID, seizure onset zone flag, and electrode type.
methods_description: Independent 3 s single-channel iEEG clips from SEEG contacts were concatenated per subject and contact at 5000 Hz and converted to BrainVision BIDS format. Events mark clip boundaries and retain the original label, segment_id, anatomy, reviewer_id, SOZ flag, and electrode type. Electrode coordinates were not released.
